items.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
items.summary: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.

items.title: Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models
items.summary: Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue says he has produced the first technical evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group are using Nvidia's latest Blackwell GPUs despite US export controls. His forensic method reads characteristic chip signatures directly from published model weights. He estimates the hardware behind the five training runs cost more than half a billion dollars....

items.title: Claude Meetings lets Anthropic's AI join your video calls
items.summary: Anthropic is adding Claude directly to video calls. Claude Meetings joins Google Meet sessions and creates documents, whiteboards, and meeting notes in real time. The feature launches in beta for Team and Enterprise plans, with more platforms coming later. The article Claude Meetings lets Anthropic's AI join your video calls appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.

items.title: OpenAI enters the cybersecurity market with two Daybreak products
items.summary: OpenAI has launched two security products under its Daybreak brand. The article OpenAI enters the cybersecurity market with two Daybreak products appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
items.summary: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary: Tin AI từ Google DeepMind về "Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen". Mở bài gốc để đọc chi tiết và đánh giá tác động với team.

items.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
items.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that....

items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.

items.title: Azure Logic Apps Standard Gets a Local CLI in Preview
items.summary: Microsoft has released a public preview of the logicapp extension for the Azure CLI, adding local project creation, workflow authoring, a runtime lifecycle, connector management, run inspection, and test scaffolding for Logic Apps Standard, work that previously required the VS Code extension. The product team pitches the terminal surface as determinism for AI-assisted development. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
items.summary: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.
